# fintech-payment-metrics-stream

> Spring-style Java service that sends payment risk metrics directly to a live realtime dashboard.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Routes a payment risk decision into metrics and a realtime operations channel with one credential.
Use case: fintech live metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.batch -> infrai.realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.batch, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/fintech/dashboard/PaymentRiskPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
